spans.s:
Kubera Vārakya is mentioned in a list of teachers in the
Jaiminīya Upaniṣad Brāhmaṇa (iii. 41, 1) as a pupil of
Jayanta Vārakya.

Kūbara in the Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā (ii. 1, 11) and Kūbarī
in the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa (iv. 6, 9, 11. 12) and the Kauṣītaki
Brāhmaṇa (xxvii. 6) denote the pole of a cart.
